nodes.label: Task status loop (§0)
nodes.rationale: TASKS.md on main is the only source of truth; agents sync, pick, claim ([~] pushed to main), build, mark [x] in own PR, repeat so parallel lanes never collide.

nodes.label: Contracts before code
nodes.rationale: Wave 0 freezes packages/shared so backend and frontend build against the contract, not each other.

nodes.label: One owner per file
nodes.rationale: Exclusive write paths per lane prevent merge conflicts; cross-lane needs go through CONTRACT-CHANGE.

nodes.label: CONTRACT-CHANGE process (§5)
nodes.rationale: Contract drift breaks parallel work; only Lane A edits packages/shared, ships both shapes where possible and updates the mock in the same PR.

nodes.label: Cut order / never cut
nodes.rationale: If behind, cut D8 → C5 → C4/E5 → D7 → E4; never cut auth, report rules, access control or the security pass.

nodes.label: Stub, don't wait
nodes.rationale: Use the mock and // TODO(contract) instead of blocking on a dependency.

nodes.label: Render deploy (doch1-web, doch1-api)
nodes.rationale: Web moved from Vercel to Render static site because Vercel free plan can't deploy private org repos.

nodes.label: access-matrix.test.ts
nodes.rationale: Table-driven; compares against Fastify router so a new Lane C route without a matrix row fails the build.

hyperedges.label: Wave 0 contract freeze unblocks parallel lanes
